pairs.registryProposal: import-validation's secrets-quarantine rule assumes the vault is DOWNSTREAM of the import (strip values, emit a credential requirement); when the import's destination IS the credential vault the rule inverts - values must be carried end to end and the loss of a value is the disclosure failure. The technique should name that precondition.
